name: Frank Moore
role: Pyramid Park Hotel keeper; manager of the KC cattle ranch
bio: Frank Moore was an old-timer of Little Missouri who gave the Cow Boy a petrified cedar knot for its Bad Lands museum in February 1884 and planned a dairy with John Nelson. That month he took E. G. Paddock into partnership in running the Pyramid Park Hotel, which A. Boyd took over in September 1884. He was listed in 1885 as manager for E. W. Casey & Co. and sold KC cattle in St. Paul that November. In February 1886 L. C. Hunt bought his interest in the KC ranch, and he left for Minneapolis with his father, Capt. Moore, hoping to obtain a post-tradership.
